user.title: Log in to Aula with MitID
user.description: Aula Connect logs in to Aula with your MitID, as you do on aula.dk. You approve by scanning a QR code with the MitID app on your phone.

data_description.id: What this Aula login is called in Home Assistant, such as the family's name.
data_description.mitid_username: The user ID you log in to MitID with.

authenticate.title: Log in with MitID
authenticate.description: Approve the login by scanning the QR code with the MitID app on your phone. If no page opens, open the [MitID login]({login_path}) yourself.

auth_error.title: Login failed
auth_error.description: The MitID login failed. Select Next to try again.

reauth_username.title: MitID user ID needed
reauth_username.description: Enter the user ID you log in to MitID with, to log in to Aula again.

reconfigure.title: Change the MitID login
reconfigure.description: Change the MitID user ID. Afterwards you approve with MitID.

data_description.mitid_username: The user ID you log in to MitID with.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to Aula again
reauth_confirm.description: Aula no longer accepts the login of MitID user ID {username}. Select Next, and approve with MitID.

login_expired.message: The login to Aula has expired. Log in with MitID again.

entry_not_loaded.message: The Aula Connect entry is not loaded.

child_not_found.message: The Aula Connect entry has no child with the id {child_id}.

thread_not_found.message: No thread {thread_id} about the child can be replied in. Choose one of the child's threads.

request_not_found.message: The child has no vacation request {request_id}.

no_sick_route.message: Aula offers no way to report this child sick. Tell the institution another way.

write_failed.message: Aula did not confirm it, and may or may not have done it; look in Aula before trying again: {error}

important_not_found.message: The task is not on the list.

important_only_ticked.message: What is important comes from the weekly plan: it can only be ticked, and only at home.

sick_report_final.message: This sick report cannot be taken back from here.

sick_reports_not_allowed.message: Reporting sick is turned off in Aula Connect's options.

vacations_not_allowed.message: Registering and deleting vacations is turned off in Aula Connect's options.

vacation_requests_not_allowed.message: Answering vacation requests is turned off in Aula Connect's options.

messages_not_allowed.message: Replying in threads is turned off in Aula Connect's options.

sick_report_unconfirmed.message: The sick report was not confirmed, and may or may not have been registered. Look in Aula before trying again.

sick_report_unprepared.message: The child cannot be reported sick from here. Report sick in Aula.

unknown_notification_area.title: Aula sends notifications Aula Connect does not know
unknown_notification_area.description: Aula sent notifications of a kind Aula Connect does not know yet: {details}. Download the diagnostics from the integration's entry and share them with the developer, so that Aula Connect can learn them. The download replaces all Aula says but how it is built; read it through before sharing it all the same.

unreadable_response.title: Aula Connect could not read an answer from Aula
unreadable_response.description: Aula Connect could not read Aula's answer to: {details}. Aula may have changed it. Download the diagnostics from the integration's entry and share them with the developer. The download replaces all Aula says but how it is built; read it through before sharing it all the same.

unknown_shape.title: Aula sends answers in a new shape
unknown_shape.description: Aula sent fields or types Aula Connect has not seen before: {details}. It may work as before; to keep Aula Connect up to date, download the diagnostics from the integration's entry and share them with the developer. The download replaces all Aula says but how it is built; read it through before sharing it all the same.

api_version_changed.title: Aula's API has a new version
api_version_changed.description: Aula's API is at version {details}, which Aula Connect was not made for. It may work as before; if anything is missing, download the diagnostics from the integration's entry and share them with the developer. The download replaces all Aula says but how it is built; read it through before sharing it all the same.

read.name: Read from Aula
read.description: Reads one method of Aula's API that only gets, with GET or with a body by POST, and answers with who someone is replaced, as the diagnostics do. Only an administrator may use it. What is revealed with Reveal is no longer anonymous.

config_entry_id.name: Aula account
config_entry_id.description: The Aula Connect entry to read with.

method.name: Method
method.description: A method of Aula's API known to exist, or another whose name starts with get or find after its area, spelt as Aula spells it. A method Aula asks by POST needs a body.

reveal.name: Reveal
reveal.description: The keys whose values are kept as Aula sent them, such as ["widgetCategory"], or true for the whole answer. What is revealed is no longer anonymous: share it only in private. The MitID username and every token stay hidden.

body.name: Body
body.description: Sent as JSON with POST, for a method Aula asks that way, such as calendar.getEventsByProfileIdsAndResourceIds. Left out, the method is asked with GET.

report_sick.name: Report sick
report_sick.description: Reports the child sick today at the institution Aula has it at, the way the institution lets guardians do so, and responds with the way it was reported. Only today. At some institutions a sick report cannot be taken back. To write to the institution, use Send message.

config_entry_id.name: Aula account
config_entry_id.description: The Aula Connect entry of the guardian it is done as.

child_id.name: Child
child_id.description: The child's id: the attribute child_id of its picture entity.

undo_sick.name: Take back sick report
undo_sick.description: Takes back today's report that the child is sick, where Aula tells the child as sick today.

config_entry_id.name: Aula account
config_entry_id.description: The Aula Connect entry of the guardian it is done as.

child_id.name: Child
child_id.description: The child's id: the attribute child_id of its picture entity.

add_vacation.name: Register vacation
add_vacation.description: Registers a vacation or time off in Aula, whole days. The start is today or later, the end at most a year after it.

config_entry_id.name: Aula account
config_entry_id.description: The Aula Connect entry of the guardian it is done as.

child_ids.name: Children
child_ids.description: The ids of the children it is for: the attribute child_id of their picture entities.

delete_vacation.name: Delete vacation
delete_vacation.description: Deletes a vacation registered for one of the children, where Aula lets it be changed.

config_entry_id.name: Aula account
config_entry_id.description: The Aula Connect entry of the guardian it is done as.

vacation_id.name: Vacation
vacation_id.description: The vacation's id, as the card lists it.

answer_vacation_request.name: Answer vacation request
answer_vacation_request.description: Answers the institution's vacation request: for each weekday from today, whether the child comes, with its times where the request asks for them.

config_entry_id.name: Aula account
config_entry_id.description: The Aula Connect entry of the guardian it is done as.

child_id.name: Child
child_id.description: The child's id: the attribute child_id of its picture entity.

request_id.name: Request
request_id.description: The request's id, as the card lists it.

days.name: Days
days.description: A list of days, each with date, is_coming, and entry_time and exit_time where the request asks for times.

send_message.name: Send message
send_message.description: Replies in one of the child's threads in Aula, to everyone in it. Nothing is sent without a thread.

config_entry_id.name: Aula account
config_entry_id.description: The Aula Connect entry of the guardian it is done as.

child_id.name: Child
child_id.description: The child's id: the attribute child_id of its picture entity.

thread_id.name: Thread
thread_id.description: The thread's id, as the card lists the child's threads.

probe_widgets.name: Probe widget services
probe_widgets.description: Follows once, as a browser does, how each Aula widget with a login of its own (such as IST's into Tabulex) logs the guardian in, reads its service's scripts and the addresses they name, and answers with how each step, page and answer is built: JSON pseudonymised, never a value of a token, cookie or field. It never reads an address that names a change. Only an administrator may use it.

config_entry_id.name: Aula account
config_entry_id.description: The Aula Connect entry of the guardian it is done as.

reads.name: Further addresses
reads.description: Addresses, or paths on the page each login ends at, read with GET too.

check_sick_report.name: Check sick report
check_sick_report.description: Tells whether the child can be reported sick from here, and where, and sends nothing: the route, whether the child is found there, at the institution Aula has it at, whether it is reported sick today already, and the request a report would send. It works whatever the options allow.

config_entry_id.name: Aula account
config_entry_id.description: The Aula Connect entry of the guardian it is done as.

child_id.name: Child
child_id.description: The child's id: the attribute child_id of its picture entity.

init.title: What Aula Connect may change in Aula
init.description: Each kind of change is off until you turn it on. What is off, neither the cards, the actions nor an AI assistant can do; reading Aula is always allowed.

data_description.allow_sick_reports: Report a child sick today, and take it back where that can be done. At some institutions a sick report cannot be taken back.
data_description.allow_vacations: Register a vacation for the children, and delete one.
data_description.allow_vacation_requests: Answer an institution's vacation request, day by day.
data_description.allow_messages: Reply in a thread about a child, to everyone in it. A new thread is never started.
